rules.visibleForm: Route SVG Masters are authoritative visual truth.
rules.responsive: Use responsive.json for transitions not visible in the two master viewports.
rules.data: CMS content may change text/images but must preserve card/gallery geometry and hierarchy.
rules.priceArea: Price and area are public in cards/details and filterable.
rules.logo: Do not crop or invent a production logo. Use text treatment until native logo source is supplied.
rules.font: Be Vietnam Pro only unless a new approved UI revision changes it.
mustNot: Do not replace with generic component library defaults.
Do not treat browser implementation as visual truth.
Do not add/remove visible sections independently.
